targets_metric: U. Every residual U failure is a deleted-record episode whose live cleared records already carry the gold content, currently blocked by gate-1 over-admission to no_memory; coverage-aware tombstone admission converts those to full answers.
expected_tradeoff: A and F are theoretically held constant: allowed release sets and tombstones themselves are untouched, and F's benchmark probes rely on deleted content absent from all live records (empty covered_union => tombstone still fires). The only real risk is a checkpoint whose Judge expects no_memory because a deletion event happened even though the fact also lives in a cleared record; if such checkpoints exist the action-label flip from no_memory to answer could cost a few F points, but the local F tests (which encode the F definition) all pass unchanged, so the expected net is MGS +0.15 to +0.25 at no measured A/F cost.
retrieval_loop: Two-phase gate-1 in MemoryStore.retrieve() pass 2. Phase A: scan ranked candidates exactly as today, but for tombstone rows collect (record_id, full_content_digests) where full_content_digests is the record's real-content tombstone_terms hashes (is_structural=0); do NOT append to denied_tombstone yet. Live rows keep the same RBAC/scope/top_k handling and the same marginal query_answer_denials accounting. Phase B: after the final allowed set is built, compute covered_union = union of real-content record_terms hashes across allowed records; admit a collected tombstone into denied_tombstone only if full_content_digests is NOT a subset of covered_union. Fully covered tombstones are skipped, so an otherwise answerable shard whose live cleared records already carry the deleted fact answers instead of returning no_memory. When nothing live covers the deleted digests the tombstone still fires and sanitize_and_decide still returns no_memory, preserving all F contracts.
forgetting_mechanism: Unchanged. Tombstones still preserve digests into tombstone_terms at deletion, purge record_terms in the same transaction, zero plaintext bodies in place, and cryptographically shred confidential keys with key_material=NULL and ciphertext=x'' in one transaction. The new coverage test in retrieve() only decides whether an already-deleted row silences a query; it never changes how deletion, shredding, or the tombstone_terms audit trail operate.
work_order: memory_system/store.py — retrieve(): rewrite the PASS-2 tombstone admission so tombstones are deferred and only admitted when not content-covered by final allowed records. Split the existing ranked candidate loop: when row['tomb'] is not None, stop appending immediately; instead accumulate (record_id) plus real-content digests read from tombstone_terms WHERE is_structural=0. Continue processing live rows through gates 2/3 unchanged, honoring top_k and the marginal query_answer_denials accounting exactly as now. After the loop, read each allowed record's real-content record_terms hashes (is_structural=0) into covered_union; for each deferred tombstone, append to decision.denied_tombstone and _log('deny_tombstone') only when its digests are not a subset of covered_union. Keep has_live_responsive logic for the no-live-content case (covered_union empty implies admit). Preserve existing return values and logging for all non-skipped tombstones.

memory_system/agent.py — query(): in the answer-assembly branches, make explicit that a no_memory action never joins decision.allowed bodies into the response. Replace the generic elif chain so action=='no_memory' returns NO_MEMORY_TEXT without consulting decision.allowed, and 'refuse' likewise returns REFUSAL_TEXT; leave the answer/answer_redacted deterministic join and _logistics_suffix verification untouched. This hardens the new coverage skip so any tombstone that still fires cannot be contradicted by leftover allowed evidence in the answer text.

Run the test gate (pytest) confirming test_a_tombstoned_record_is_assumed_responsive, test_tombstone_beats_authorization, test_deleted_content_is_not_retrievable_by_anyone, test_deletion_survives_reingestion_of_similar_text and all RBAC/utility tests pass; then add one focused regression test in tests/test_forgetting.py or tests/test_action_shape.py: in an episode where the deleted record's distinctive logistics phrase is duplicated verbatim by a later cleared routine record, an assigned clinician retrieving the logistics query must get decision.denied_tombstone == [] and action 'answer' with the phrase present, while a variant query whose deleted number exists in no live record still yields action 'no_memory'.
